m.t: ¿Cuánto va a durar esta matanza de chicos malos?

m.e: How fares our young master after the kill?

m.e: I saw you at the temple just hours before the slaughter.

m.e: Why lead those poor souls into slaughter?

m.e: Appalled by the slaughter, the country demands action.

m.e: Anything that could end this carnage?

m.e: Who made the kill?

m.e: We didn't do the killing, the hangman did.

m.e: No cow-killing stories during dinner.

m.e: We think we got an occult killing.

m.t: ¿Luego va por una matanza?

m.t: De toda esta matanza.
